segments.sn35.144:1.2: Yopi hetu, yopi paccayo rūpānaṃ uppādāya, sopi dukkho.
segments.sn35.144:1.3: Dukkhasambhūtā, bhikkhave, rūpā kuto sukhā bhavissanti!
segments.sn35.144:1.4: Saddā … gandhā … rasā … phoṭṭhabbā … dhammā dukkhā.
segments.sn35.144:1.9: Yopi hetu, yopi paccayo dhammānaṃ uppādāya, sopi dukkho.
segments.sn35.144:1.10: Dukkhasambhūtā, bhikkhave, dhammā kuto sukhā bhavissanti!
segments.sn35.144:1.11: Evaṃ passaṃ … pe …‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānātī”ti.
